# Vendor sources

This directory is reserved for third-party/vendor source files used as references or adapted examples for the **Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.47** project.

## Waveshare code

When Waveshare source files are added here:

- keep the original Waveshare copyright and license headers;
- preserve the MIT license notice for files distributed by Waveshare under MIT;
- clearly mark local modifications instead of presenting modified vendor code as original project code;
- document compatibility fixes and the reason for each non-trivial change;
- do not add unrelated files from the vendor archive unless their license and purpose are clear.

For the currently tested Arduino environment, compatibility work is being verified with:

```text
esp32 by Espressif Systems: 3.3.11
PNGdec: 1.1.6
```

The adapted files will be reviewed after they are added to this directory. Where appropriate, source headers will include a short `Modified for this project` section and the directory will receive example-specific documentation describing:

- original source/provenance;
- original license;
- tested hardware and software versions;
- changes relative to the Waveshare version;
- hardware-verification status;
- any remaining limitations or known issues.
